definition.en: The shape made by two arms from one point. Its size is how far one arm turns from the other.
definition.zh: 从一个点出发的两条边组成的图形。角的大小是一条边相对另一条边转了多少。

definition.en: The point where the two arms of an angle meet.
definition.zh: 角的两条边相交的那个点。

definition.en: One of the two straight lines that make an angle. Its length does not change the angle's size.
definition.zh: 组成角的两条直线中的一条。边的长短不改变角的大小。

definition.en: A square corner: a quarter of a full turn, 90°. It is marked with a small square.
definition.zh: 方方正正的角，是一整圈的四分之一，90°。用一个小方块标出。

definition.en: A sheet of paper folded in half and in half again. Its folded corner is a right angle, used to check other angles.
definition.zh: 把一张纸对折再对折，折出的角是直角，用来比别的角。

definition.en: Two straight lines that meet at a right angle.
definition.zh: 相交成直角的两条直线互相垂直。

definition.en: Two straight lines that go the same way and stay the same distance apart; they never meet.
definition.zh: 方向一样、之间的距离处处相等、永远不相交的两条直线互相平行。

definition.en: The unit for the size of an angle. A full turn is 360°; a right angle is 90°.
definition.zh: 量角的单位。一整圈是 360°，直角是 90°。

definition.en: A half-circle tool for measuring and drawing angles, with two rows of numbers from 0 to 180.
definition.zh: 量角、画角的半圆形工具，有两圈从 0 到 180 的数。

definition.en: The two rows of numbers on a protractor, counting in opposite directions. Read the one whose 0 lies on an arm.
definition.zh: 量角器上方向相反的两圈数。读 0 对着一条边的那一圈。

definition.en: Angles that sit on one side of a straight line and share a vertex on it. They add up to 180°.
definition.zh: 在一条直线同一侧、顶点在直线上的几个角，加起来是 180°。

definition.en: Angles that go all the way round one point. They add up to 360°.
definition.zh: 绕着一点一整圈的几个角，加起来是 360°。

definition.en: The two angles that face each other across the point where two straight lines cross. They are equal.
definition.zh: 两条直线相交时，隔着交点面对面的两个角。它们相等。

definition.en: The angles in the drawing are not their real sizes. Work them out from the numbers given; do not measure.
definition.zh: 图上的角不是真实的大小。要用标出的数来算，不要量。
